tools.name: fieldwire_get_account
tools.description: The Fieldwire account this API token belongs to: id, company name and address, enabled modules (submittals, change orders, RFIs, specs, BIM) and the owner. GET /account on the account host.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_account_users
tools.description: All users on the account (and users invited to its projects) with name, company, email, account role and the number of projects each is in. User ids are what tasks use for owner and assignees. GET /account/users on the account host.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_projects
tools.description: Projects the token's user can access in the region chosen at login: id, name, code, address, time zone, plan and archive state. Filter by name, code, archive state or update time. Use the id in every other tool. GET /api/v3/projects.

tools.name: fieldwire_get_project
tools.description: One project by id: name, code, address, time zone, currency, plan, enabled features and owner email. GET /api/v3/projects/{id}.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_project_users
tools.description: Users on one project with name, company, job title, email and phone. The integer id is what tasks use for owner_user_id and user_ids. Filter by email, name or company. GET /api/v3/account/projects/{project_id}/users.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks (punch items, issues) in a project: name, status_id, team_id, location_id, floorplan_id, owner and assignee user ids, priority, dates and cost. Filter by status, team, location, plan, owner, name, tag and dates. Resolve ids with fieldwire_list_task_statuses, _list_teams, _list_locations and _l

tools.name: fieldwire_get_task
tools.description: One task by id with all its fields. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_task_statuses
tools.description: The task statuses of a project (id, name, order, kind open/tracked/verified, default flag). Use the id as status_id on tasks. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/statuses.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_teams
tools.description: Teams of a project (id, name, handle). The Fieldwire app calls them 'categories' on tasks; tasks carry a team_id. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/teams.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_locations
tools.description: Locations of a project (id, name, parent location_id). Tasks carry a location_id. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/locations.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_task_check_items
tools.description: Checklist items of all tasks in a project: name, checked flag, state (empty/yes/no/not_applicable) and task_id (match it to the task). GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/task_check_items.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_floorplans
tools.description: Plans (floorplans) of a project: id, name, description, folder and sheet count. Filter by name, tag or dates. Set with_current_sheet to include each plan's current sheet. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/floorplans.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_sheets
tools.description: Sheets (plan versions) of a project: id, name, file name, version, floorplan_id and file URLs. Filter by plan, folder, name or dates. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/sheets.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_attachments
tools.description: Files, photos, videos and 360 photos attached in a project: id, name, kind, size, capture time and file URLs. Filter by kind. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/attachments.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_forms
tools.description: Forms (inspections, daily reports, checklists) of a project: id, name, template, status, owner, dates. Forms need a Business plan. Use fieldwire_get_form_full for the filled-in values. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/forms.

tools.name: fieldwire_get_form
tools.description: One form by id (header data only, not the filled-in values). GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/forms/{id}.

tools.name: fieldwire_get_form_full
tools.description: A form with its sections, inputs and filled-in values. Two steps: call without jid to start the job (Fieldwire answers with a jid); then call again with that jid until the form comes back (answer 'pending' means not ready, retry). GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/forms/{id}/full.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_form_templates
tools.description: Form templates of a project: id, name, version, publish state. Use the id to filter forms. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/form_templates.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_rfis
tools.description: RFIs (requests for information) of a project: number, name, question, answer, status, assignee, due date. Needs the RFI module. Filter by status, assignee, text, overdue or dates. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/rfis.

tools.name: fieldwire_list_submittals
tools.description: Submittals of a project: number, name, status, revision, key dates. Needs the submittals module. Filter by status, assignee, text, overdue or dates. GET /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/submittals.

tools.name: fieldwire_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new task in a project. It is sent once and never retried; if the reply is an error, check fieldwire_list_tasks before creating it again, or you may get a duplicate. owner_user_id and priority are required; creator_user_id defaults to the owner. Find user ids with fieldwire_list_proj

tools.name: fieldwire_update_task
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields of one task (only the fields you pass; user_ids replaces the whole assignee list; null clears a field that allows it). Use it to set the status, owner, assignees, priority or dates. It does not delete the task. Sent once, never retried. PATCH /api/v3/projects/{project_id}/tasks

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "fieldwire_list_projects" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: name_contains, code, archived, updated_after, updated_before, state, per_page, last_synced_at

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fieldwire_list_account_users, fieldwire_get_project, fieldwire_list_project_users, fieldwire_list_tasks, fieldwire_list_sheets, fieldwire_list_attachments, fieldwire_create_task · Private data: fieldwire_get_account, fieldwire_list_projects, fieldwire_list_sheets, fieldwire_list_attachments · Public sink: fieldwire_list_account_users, fieldwire_get_project, fieldwire_list_project_users, fieldwire_list_form_templates, fieldwire_create_task · Destructive: fieldwire_update_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fieldwire_list_account_users, fieldwire_get_project, fieldwire_list_project_users, fieldwire_list_tasks, fieldwire_list_sheets, fieldwire_list_attachments, fieldwire_create_task · Private data: fieldwire_get_account, fieldwire_list_projects, fieldwire_list_sheets, fieldwire_list_attachments · Public sink: fieldwire_list_account_users, fieldwire_get_project, fieldwire_list_project_users, fieldwire_list_form_templates, fieldwire_create_task · Destructive: fieldwire_update_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
